description: Implementation of data access object (DAO) for managing 'Group' entities, including retrieval based on permissions, IDs, and group type.

classes.name: GroupDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation for Group entity, with methods to retrieve groups by permissions, IDs, and group type.

methods.name: getGroupsListBypermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group entities that have permissions matching the provided set of permission IDs.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group entities based on a set of group IDs.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Retrieves groups filtered by a specific GroupType.
